status: model-graded results complete; human calibration pending
question: Does Product Sense make Claude reach better product decisions than the same model without it?
gates_before_any_session: DONE 2026-10-10: answer key approved as drafted by Alan P Currie, no amendments
DONE: source and staged-plugin hashes recorded below
DONE: harness.py dry-run end to end on simulated responses and grades; anonymiser over-stripping found and fixed
scenarios: scenarios/*.txt (10). Expected verdicts: pursue 3, park 2, reshape 2, investigate 2, design review 1. Every prompt ends with a 250-word cap so both arms answer at similar length.
holdout_policy: These scenarios are a frozen evaluation set. Do not tune SKILL.md or references against them. If the skill changes in response to this run, confirm the change on new scenarios in a later run.

arms.skill: Run 11 restricted CLI settings with --plugin-dir pointing at the staged plugin; selection is automatic, not forced

grader.plugins: none; --tools '' so it cannot load the skill
grader.pairing: Skill sample i paired with control sample i for the same scenario and model: 60 pairs
grader.anonymisation: Strip lines that mention the skill, its files or skill invocation before grading; label answers A and B only
grader.order_bias: Grade every pair twice with A/B swapped. A preference that flips counts as a tie. Item scores are the mean of the two gradings.
grader.human_calibration: The key reviewer blind-grades 10 randomly chosen pairs with the same prompt. Report agreement with the model grader on verdict and preference; if verdict agreement is below 8 of 10, treat model-graded results as unreliable.

measures.primary: Verdict accuracy: mean verdict_score per arm per model (design review excluded)
secondary: Blind pairwise win rate of skill over control (ties count half)
Verdict distribution per arm, to detect bias toward 'investigate'
Accuracy on the three pursue scenarios separately (caution bias)
Skill selection rate in the skill arm; report results for all skill-arm samples and for samples that selected the skill

decision_rules.benefit: Skill verdict accuracy at least 15 points above control on both models, or pairwise win rate at least 0.65, with no higher trap rate: claim improved judgment on this set only
decision_rules.neutral: Accuracy within 10 points and win rate between 0.40 and 0.60: report that the skill's value is process discipline, not better decisions; consider trimming guidance that does not move results
decision_rules.harm: Skill arm misses at least two more pursue-scenario samples than control on either model, or win rate below 0.40: fix the cause before any release

power_note: 30 verdicts per arm per model. Differences under about 20 points are not reliably detectable; this run screens for large effects and caution bias, not small improvements.
stopping_rule: One attempt per session. No retry on failure. Stop on authentication or quota block. No edits to scenarios, key, grader prompt or skill while sessions run. Record every failure.
limits: Synthetic scenarios with a key written by the evaluator's model family and reviewed by one human
Model grader, partly calibrated by a small human sample
Claude Code CLI only; no Codex, desktop or other-surface claim
Does not establish real-user or business outcomes
